observations: Two white desktop speakers on a wooden surface.
Left speaker has a 'logi' logo at the bottom.
Right speaker has a volume/power knob, a headphone jack, a Bluetooth pairing button, and a blue LED indicator.
The blue LED is illuminated in photos 0 and 1, indicating the unit is powered on.
Photo 2 shows a label identifying the product as 'Z207 Rich Stereo Sound with Bluetooth'.
The label lists Model: S-00168 and Logitech Europe S.A.
The label specifies power input as 5V 1.5A.
Watermarks for 'DEALS MASTER GLOBAL LIMITED' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are visible on all images.

claims.evidence: Photos only show the front and a close-up of the label; the back and sides are not visible to check for damage.
Audio quality cannot be determined from static photos.

claims.evidence: The device features Bluetooth and a 3.5mm input jack as seen in photos 0 and 2.

risks.proof: A video showing a successful Bluetooth pairing process with a mobile device.

proof_requests: Video of the speakers playing audio to confirm sound quality.
Photo of the power adapter included with the speakers.
Photos of the back and sides of both speaker units to check for physical damage.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Logitech Z207. While sound quality and accessories are unproven, it can be priced at its worst-case value as a non-functional or parts-only unit.
